ordered_steps: Independent tooling review of frozen banking v1 and staging v2; root acceptance before any invocation.

After actual landing and payload freeze, BEFORE ordinary banking and BEFORE any staging, capture git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z in WT, preserving argv/cwd, raw stdout, empty stderr and exit0 at landing/staging-untracked-before.*. Preserve the original binary NUL stream unchanged. No root landing-proof destination exists yet.

Invoke reviewed banking v1 ordinary with that capture stem. Caller stdout/stderr/exit/execution go to a fresh external run directory, not landing. Preserve complete internal run-output including write-events, result, invocation, input pins and raw HEAD command records.
Stage only actual independently authorized payload, semantic bank and ordinary bank paths. All newly staged paths outside root landing-proof must be present in the true initial raw stream.
Capture actual staged whitespace diagnostics; independently review precise classifications and retain full proofs. No guessed exemption or unknown schema is introduced by this preparation.

Create explicit final extra inventory including every ordinary run-output and caller-record file, later approved tooling/reproduction/whitespace evidence, complete original failure records. Invoke reviewed banking final-whitespace into its fresh external run-output. It adds only exact manifest targets; preserve all final bank write-events/result/command streams externally.

Stage exact remaining final root-bank targets and manifest. Do not create late files inside landing after the final manifest snapshot. Any later boundary must use an explicit separately reviewed supplement; no broad exclusions.

After final banking caller streams have completed, invoke staging v2 with both actual bank run-output directories. The final bank run is consumed and pinned as later external evidence, not falsely covered by its own earlier manifest. Capture this verifier caller argv/stdout/stderr/exit/execution outside landing and outside its own fresh internal --output.

Review actual verifier output and preserve its external tree. This pre-commit check does not cover later files or mutations. Do not bank its own output into its own successful stage without a new separately reviewed boundary.

untracked_contract.initial_boundary: before ordinary banking and before initial staging
untracked_contract.derive_new_paths: required staged set minus actual baseline git ls-tree; exact match to actual cached diff-filter=A paths
untracked_contract.later_bank_paths: exact final root-manifest copy targets plus both manifests; exact ordinary/final actual write events, excluding only their external landing manifest writes
untracked_contract.residual: original raw order with only initially listed independently authorized newly staged paths removed; byte-exact comparison to current raw untracked stream
untracked_contract.reject: unrelated additions/drops, new non-bank paths absent initially, initial root-bank paths, missing/extra bank events, missing/changed capture pins

future_prerequisites: Actual root-bank manifests and complete run evidence
Actual independently approved whitespace proof/log in the expected interface
Actual complete staged set; none executed by this preparation
